records.summary: AgenticRoboRL improves robot planners via supervised fine-tuning and multi-turn reinforcement learning across diverse harnesses, significantly boosting success rates without external memory.

records.title: FrontierSmith: Synthesizing Open-Ended Coding Problems at Scale
records.summary: FrontierSmith automates the creation of open-ended coding problems from closed-ended tasks, improving LLM coding performance on benchmarks through diverse problem variants and enhanced agent interactions.

records.title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
records.summary: Video-Coder is a code-driven video generation agent that writes and executes code to build structured 3D draft videos, then uses supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with execution and video rewards to improve controllable video generation.

records.title: AutoTrainess: Teaching Language Models to Improve Language Models Autonomously
records.summary: AutoTrainess enables autonomous language model training by providing structured agent-computer interfaces that guide planning, data preparation, training, evaluation, and logging operations more effectively than traditional command-line approaches.

records.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
records.summary: The benchmark evaluates autonomous coding agents on open-ended world-model research by having them iteratively improve a starter model across game environments using a shared structured-state format.
